value:
2026-05-06 (post-v1.14.0 ship): Strategic conversation. Decided to rebrand codexCLI → Reverie and launch as Reverie v1.0.0 (new product launch, not codexCLI v2.0.0). Three commercial inbound signals (multiple GitHub inquiries + employer informal interest) anchor a consulting-led GTM via SeaBear Studios.

NEW FOUNDATIONAL ENTRIES — read these on bootstrap before doing anything else:
- project.identity — Reverie thesis, bicameral framing, naming convention (load-bearing: "the codex" stays as data-layer noun; codex_* MCP tool names preserved)
- project.releasePlan — v1.0.0 phased plan, supersedes project.v114Plan / project.v115Hints
- project.commercialContext — inbound interest, OSS+consulting GTM, employer path
- context.binaryName — rvr chosen, rejection rationale (rev/re/rv all blocked)

USER STATE:
"A lot to think about." Wrapped session intentionally early — needs reflection time before committing to execution. DO NOT push for action on next bootstrap; let user direct. They may return with refinements, second thoughts, or new angles before any phase-1 work begins.

PENDING PRE-FLIGHT (only if user wants to advance Phase 1):
- Domain check: whois reverie.dev, reverie.ai, reverie.io
- USPTO trademark search Class 9 + 42 (~10 min DIY, uspto.gov)
- Bun validate-phase (½ day): install Bun, run tests under Bun, run MCP server under Bun, verify @modelcontextprotocol/sdk works. THIS IS THE GATE — if MCP breaks under Bun, runtime swap is off the table.

CONVERSATION REGISTER:
This was meta/strategic, not implementation work. User explicitly asked for "more meta" framing early. Engaged deeply on architecture, branding, GTM — not code. Match that register if they continue the thread.

DON'T:
- Open a v1.15 milestone (the soak-cycle plan was superseded by the rebrand decision)
- Reframe Reverie as v2.0.0 (decision was deliberate — see project.releasePlan)
- Push timeline (8-12 week launch is evenings/weekends; user has day job + dev firm)
- Substitute for accountant/lawyer on commercial structuring

OPEN THREADS user may pick up next:
- Visual identity for Reverie (logo, palette, Westworld-light touches)
- "Reverie for Teams" / SeaBear consulting page positioning + tier structure
- Bun migration validate-phase (Phase 1 gate)
- Trademark / domain pre-flight
- Dogfooding Part Three writing (natural pairing with rebrand launch)
- Outreach scripting for GitHub inbound responses
